harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 15 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, and node3 (standbys) on RHEL 7.9, secured with TLS using a cluster-specific CA, restricting replication connections to peers presenting CA-issued client certificates. All three nodes were restarted one at a time (standbys first, primary last) with quorum preserved throughout; each node's changed boot identity and full recovery of PostgreSQL service, replication, and data were verified.
actions_performed: Diagnosed and fixed RHEL7 repo issues: corrected $releasever mismatch (7Server vs 7) in PGDG repo baseurls, disabled EOL pgdg12/13 mirrors, installed EPEL-7 from Fedora archives to satisfy libzstd dependency, then installed postgresql15-server/contrib on node1, node2, node3
Initialized PGDATA on node1 as the primary via postgresql-15-setup initdb
Generated a dedicated cluster CA (postgres-cluster-ca) on node1; issued TLS server certs for node1/node2/node3 and a client cert (CN=replicator) for replication auth, all signed by that CA
Distributed the CA cert, server certs, and replicator client cert to node2/node3 over SSH using the cluster keypair, with correct ownership/permissions under the postgres user
Configured postgresql.conf on all nodes with ssl=on and node-specific ssl_cert_file/ssl_key_file/ssl_ca_file; set wal_level, max_wal_senders, max_replication_slots, hot_standby on node1

Configured pg_hba.conf on node1 to accept replication connections only via hostssl with cert auth method scoped to node2/node3 IPs, implicitly requiring verify-full client cert validation against ssl_ca_file
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all three nodes
Created the replicator role (REPLICATION LOGIN) and physical replication slots (node2_slot, node3_slot) on node1
Ran pg_basebackup from node1 over TLS (sslmode=verify-full, client cert auth) to bootstrap node2 and node3 as standbys with primary_conninfo/primary_slot_name auto-configured
Verified end-to-end replication: both standbys streaming async over SSL with client_dn=/CN=replicator; test rows written on primary appeared on both standbys
Verified enforcement: a replication attempt without a client certificate was rejected by pg_hba

Captured boot_id baseline on all nodes, then restarted node2, node3, and node1 sequentially (one at a time), confirming changed boot_id, service reactivation, replication reconnection, and data consistency after each restart

evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows node2 (10.100.34.11) and node3 (10.100.34.12) streaming async; test row inserted on primary appeared on both standbys

evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a cluster-created CA
evidence.summary: Created postgres-cluster-ca (ca.crt/ca.key) on node1; pg_stat_ssl joined to pg_stat_replication shows ssl=t and client_dn=/CN=replicator for both standby connections, both before and after the full restart sequence

evidence.requirement: Only peers presenting a CA-issued certificate are accepted for replication
evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf restricts replication to hostssl+cert method scoped to node2/node3 IPs; a connection attempt without a client certificate was rejected (FATAL: no pg_hba.conf entry ... SSL encryption) while attempts presenting the CA-issued replicator cert succeeded

Baseline boot_id d72bd4ec...; systemctl reboot issued; boot_id changed to 938def43...; postgresql-15 active, pg_is_in_recovery=f, both standbys reconnected streaming, and a post-restart test row replicated to node2 and node3
Baseline boot_id d7a80301...; systemctl reboot issued; boot_id changed to ca95c822... with uptime 0 min; postgresql-15 active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, and node1 shows node2 reconnected streaming
Baseline boot_id 73bafeef...; systemctl reboot issued; boot_id changed to 228d9c79... with uptime 0 min; postgresql-15 active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, and node1 shows node3 reconnected streaming

evidence.requirement: Quorum/independent recovery path preserved during restarts
evidence.summary: Only one node was restarted at a time; before restarting node1 (primary), both standbys were confirmed healthy and streaming, and node1 itself was only restarted after both standbys had already recovered from their own restarts
